comment: Functions whose constant result is the correct Windows behaviour on OSyx, each with the reason. The scanner counts them as implemented and lists them in the report; a function not named here that returns a constant is reported as a stub.

entries.IsDebuggerPresent: OSyx has no debugger interface for Win32 processes, so no process is ever being debugged and FALSE is the exact answer
entries.GdiFlush: drawing reaches PRISM in order already (see the comment at the function), so there is no batch to flush
entries.CallNextHookEx: hooks are never installed (SetWindowsHookExW fails), so there is no next hook: 0 is the result at the end of an empty chain
entries.InSendMessage: window procedures run on the sender's thread here, so none is ever handling a message sent from another thread: FALSE is exact
entries.InSendMessageEx: as InSendMessage: ISMEX_NOSEND (0) is the answer when no cross-thread send is being handled
entries.ReplyMessage: as InSendMessage: Windows fails with FALSE when the procedure is not handling a message sent from another thread
entries.NotifyWinEvent: SetWinEventHook never installs a hook, so there is no listener to notify
entries.IsAppThemed: OSyx has no visual styles: this is what Windows answers with themes off
entries.IsThemeActive: OSyx has no visual styles: this is what Windows answers with themes off
entries.OpenThemeData: OSyx has no visual styles: Windows returns NULL when no theme is active and callers fall back to classic drawing
entries.SHChangeNotify: SHChangeNotifyRegister is not provided, so no listener can exist and a notification has nobody to reach
entries.SetOaNoCache: the BSTR allocator of OSyx has no cache, so there is nothing to switch off
entries.Commit: IPropertyStore in memory (propsys.rs) has no backing file: committing has nothing to write
entries.DnsFree: DnsQuery never returns records, so there is nothing to free
entries.FaceReleaseFontTable: tables point into the face's file data, which lives as long as the face (see the comment at the function)
entries.StreamReleaseFileFragment: fragments point into the stream's byte buffer, which lives as long as the stream
entries.loader_ref: the local font file loader is a process-wide singleton: references do nothing, by design of IDWriteFontFileLoader
entries.IsGUIThread: every thread of a winrun process can use USER at once (its message queue is made on first use), as on Windows once user32 is loaded
entries.GetKeyboardLayout: OSyx has one keyboard layout (US, HKL 0x04090409) for every thread, so that is the answer for any thread id
entries.UiaClientsAreListening: OSyx has no UI Automation client, so nobody is listening
entries.UiaReturnRawElementProvider: with no UI Automation client no WM_GETOBJECT is answered: 0 is the not-handled result
entries.UiaRaiseAutomationEvent: with no listening client an event has nobody to reach; Windows returns S_OK then
entries.UiaRaiseAutomationPropertyChangedEvent: with no listening client a change has nobody to reach; Windows returns S_OK then
entries.singleton_ref: COM AddRef/Release of static objects: the count never changes, 1 is the Windows result for a static singleton
entries.StreamCommit: a memory stream has nothing to flush or roll back: Windows returns S_OK (probed)
entries.StreamRevert: a memory stream has nothing to flush or roll back: Windows returns S_OK (probed)
entries.FtmDisconnectObject: the free-threaded marshaler keeps no per-client state, so there is nothing to disconnect; Windows returns S_OK
